title: He Leaked GTA 6 From A Hotel Room
notes: Narration EN, voix Fish 'rick' (voice/). Faits et sources: research/SOURCES.md. Aucune marque Rockstar/GTA dessinée: le jeu = écrans flous, boîte générique « 6 ». Droits: personnages de notre distribution.

voice.text: He leaked the biggest video game on earth from a hotel room using nothing but a TV stick and a phone. You see, he was 18, already on bail for hacking and hiding in that hotel under police protection. So he plugged the stick into the TV, grabbed a keyboard and slipped into Rockstar's private chat. Then he dropped over 90 clips of the secret game for the whole internet to see. Rockstar says the leak cost them $5 million and thousands of hours of work. But the court said he wasn't fit to stand trial. So instead of prison, he was locked in a secure hospital, maybe for life, and the leak didn't kill the game. A year later, the real trailer became the most watched non -music video on YouTube in a single day. Then this year, doctors decided he was fit for trial after all, and he was moved back to prison. And just three days before GTA 6 finally came out, he pleaded guilty. So the guy who showed the world GTA 6 first will probably be the last one to play it.

warn_reasons.recipe vs plan wording: the matcher compares the first words of each recipe line; the remaining 'maybe forgotten' lines were read one by one: either covered in other words (fall, gust, gesture, LED) or not relevant to this action (a TV that stays OFF does not light up; typing is not a door)
warn_reasons.no recipe for clips_fly / pigeon / troph: new actions of this film: their recipes are written to library/reactions/reactions.json after they are built (rule: every new action becomes a recipe)

risks: the game must never look like Rockstar's assets: generic blurred screens only
